policies.title: Anguilla: live selector eVisa-eligible ordinary passports
policies.summary: The live Anguilla selector directly labels these catalog ISO2 passport codes ‘Visa Required’; the same government portal provides the electronic visitor-visa application and states that an approved electronic visa establishes travel eligibility.
conditions: An approved electronic visa establishes travel eligibility but does not guarantee admission; arrival inspection and inadmissibility controls apply.
It excludes residence, work, transit, crew, diplomatic, official/service, special-document, purpose, duration and individual-waiver routes.

policies.title: Anguilla: live selector visa-not-required ordinary passports
policies.summary: The live Anguilla selector directly labels these catalog ISO2 passport codes ‘Visa Not Required’.
conditions: It excludes residence, work, transit, crew, diplomatic, official/service, special-document, purpose, duration, admission and individual-waiver routes.

policies.title: Turks and Caicos: named visa-exempt ordinary passports
policies.summary: The current Border Force page expressly lists these nationalities as visa-exempt.
conditions: Valid passport and border-officer admission remain required.
Residence permits, UK/US/Canada visas, work, transit, crew, citizenship/status, diplomatic, official/service and special documents are not normalized.

policies.title: Turks and Caicos: residual ordinary passports require advance visa
policies.summary: The current Border Force page expressly says citizens outside its visa-exempt list must obtain a visa.
conditions: UK/US/Canada residence or a valid visa is conditional, not nationality-wide access.
Application is neither eVisa nor visa on arrival.
Admission, work, transit, crew, citizenship/status, diplomatic, official/service and special-document rules remain separate.

policies.title: Falkland Islands: named visa-national ordinary passports
policies.summary: The current Customs and Immigration page expressly names these nationalities as requiring a visa.
conditions: Visas must be secured in advance; the visitor permit is a separate arrival stamp, not visa on arrival.
Visitor permits prohibit employment and require onward travel, accommodation, funds and medical-evacuation insurance.
No status is inferred for omitted passports or status/document exceptions.

policies.title: Cayman Islands: current table visa-not-required ordinary passports
policies.summary: The current CBC visitor table expressly labels these named ordinary-passport nationalities ‘Visa Not Required’.
conditions: The table’s residence, work-permit, re-entry-permit and third-country document waivers are conditional and are not normalized.
Taiwan’s listed exemption is limited to an ordinary passport issued by its Ministry of Foreign Affairs that includes the personal identification number.
Admission, duration, work, transit, crew, diplomatic, official/service and special-document rules remain separate.

policies.title: Cayman Islands: current table visa-required ordinary passports
policies.summary: The current CBC visitor table expressly labels these named ordinary-passport nationalities ‘Visa Required Unless Exempted’. The portal documents an online pre-travel application but does not directly establish electronic visa issuance, so this remains advance visa required rather than eVisa.
conditions: Visitor visa must be applied for before travel; the official page describes an online application, but does not state that the issued visa is electronic.
The table’s work, residence, re-entry permit, US/Canada/UK resident and specified third-country-visa waivers are conditional and are not normalized.
Admission, duration, work, transit, crew, diplomatic, official/service and special-document rules remain separate.
